definitions.full: H5380. nashab [ נָשַׁב ] verb blow (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; נְשַׁב ᵑ7 (but also נְחַב ), Syriac , all blow ; || form of נָשַׁף ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular י ׳רוּחַ בּוֺ נָָֽשְׁבָה Isa 40:7 the breath of ׳י has blown upon it . Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular רוּחַ יַשֵּׁב Psa 147:18 he causes his wind to blow ; אֹתָם וַיַּשֵּׁב Gen 15:11 and he drove them away (perhaps originally blow away , drive away by blowing, or by a sound like blowing).
